data.title: Leicester vs Wigan Prediction, Odds & Betting Tips | 27.10.2026 | League One
data.content:
Gary Caldwell is under pressure at Wigan. The team is not playing well, especially in attack, as they scored only eight goals in 11 league matches. The game at King Power Stadium could be Caldwell's last as Wigan's manager.

Wigan will travel to Leicester without suspended Fraser Murray, while Luke Harris and Ryan Trevitt are injured. Also, Max Power is questionable, and his status will get clearer closer to the kickoff.
